import argparse
import re
from pysilfont.ufo import Ufo
from pysilfont.ftml import FTML
from pysilfont.csvreader import csvreader
from pysilfont.ftml import addfontinfo, addChar, addSpecial, addLigature, addLamAlef, addDiacriticAttachment
from pysilfont.ftml import writeXMLobject

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate FTML from UFO and glyph data CSV using pysilfont.")
    parser.add_argument("--input-ufo", required=True, help="Input UFO directory")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="Output FTML file")
    parser.add_argument("--glyph-info-csv", required=True, help="Glyph info CSV file")
    parser.add_argument("--font-code", required=False, help="Font code")
    parser.add_argument("--log", required=False, help="Log file name")
    parser.add_argument("--langtags", nargs='*', default=[], help="List of BCP47 language tags")
    parser.add_argument("--rtl", action="store_true", help="Enable right-to-left feature")
    parser.add_argument("--no-render-check", action="store_true", help="Disable rendering check")
    parser.add_argument("--test-name", required=False, help="Test name")
    parser.add_argument("--font-src", required=False, help="Font source")
    parser.add_argument("--text-scaling", type=float, default=1.0, help="Text scaling factor")
    parser.add_argument("--anchor-regex", required=False, help="Anchor points regular expression")
    parser.add_argument("--total-width", type=int, default=1000, help="Total width of all string column")
    parser.add_argument("--xsl", required=False, help="XSL stylesheet")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Load UFO font
    ufo = Ufo(args.input_ufo)

    # Read glyph info CSV
    glyph_data = []
    with open(args.glyph_info_csv, encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
        reader = csvreader(csvfile)
        for row in reader:
            glyph_data.append(row)

    # Initialize FTML document
    ftml = FTML()
    if args.xsl:
        ftml.xsl = args.xsl
    if args.test_name:
        ftml.testname = args.test_name
    if args.font_src:
        ftml.fontsrc = args.font_src
    if args.font_code:
        ftml.fontcode = args.font_code
    if args.langtags:
        for lang in args.langtags:
            ftml.setLang(lang)
    if args.rtl:
        ftml.rtl = True
    if args.no_render_check:
        ftml.rendercheck = False
    if args.text_scaling:
        ftml.scale = args.text_scaling
    if args.total_width:
        ftml.totalwidth = args.total_width

    # Add font info
    addfontinfo(ftml, ufo)

    # Regex for anchor points if provided
    anchor_regex = re.compile(args.anchor_regex) if args.anchor_regex else None

    # Process glyph data
    for row in glyph_data:
        glyph_name = row.get("glyph_name") or row.get("name")
        unicode_val = row.get("unicode")
        is_special = row.get("special")
        is_ligature = row.get("ligature")
        is_lam_alef = row.get("lam_alef")
        is_diacritic = row.get("diacritic")
        anchors = row.get("anchors", "")

        # Add encoded characters
        if unicode_val and not is_special and not is_ligature and not is_lam_alef and not is_diacritic:
            addChar(ftml, glyph_name, unicode_val)

        # Add unencoded specials
        if is_special:
            addSpecial(ftml, glyph_name)

        # Add ligatures
        if is_ligature:
            addLigature(ftml, glyph_name)

        # Add Lam-Alef data
        if is_lam_alef:
            addLamAlef(ftml, glyph_name)

        # Add diacritic attachment data
        if is_diacritic and anchors:
            anchor_list = anchors.split(";")
            filtered_anchors = [a for a in anchor_list if not anchor_regex or anchor_regex.match(a)]
            addDiacriticAttachment(ftml, glyph_name, filtered_anchors)

    # Write FTML file
    writeXMLobject(ftml, args.output)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
